title: 🃏 Card
description: A universal, schema.org-driven card. One structured envelope (headline, summary, media, authors, actions, engagement…) shared by every card, a `schemaType` discriminator covering 53 schema.org types (50 distinct itemtypes — `profile` and `artist` both resolve to Person; `comparison`, `places` and `filelist` all to ItemList), and a single `details` object for type-specific data. Presentation (variant/media/content tokens for <ui-card>/<ui-reveal>) deliberately lives OUTSIDE this model — in a referenced card-preset — so the same card can render as hero, grid item, overlay or flip by swapping one reference.

layout.name: Media
layout.description: Media items (more than one becomes a carousel) and overlay furniture

layout.name: Navigation
layout.description: Tags, call-to-action buttons and related links

layout.name: Type Details
layout.description: Schema-type-specific data, the look & feel preset, and the optional reveal flipside

internalName.title: Internal Name
internalName.description: Internal name for CMS editors — not displayed on the front end

schemaType.title: Schema Type
schemaType.description: schema.org content type. Drives the emitted itemtype, the microdata property mapping (headline → headline/name/title, summary → description/reviewBody) and which `details` shape applies.

options.label: Places — a collection on one map (ItemList)

chip.title: Status chip
chip.description:
A short status flag at the very top of the TEXT column, above the eyebrow — "New", "Sold", "Last places". Either one object or an ARRAY of them when a listing carries several flags; they render as one

row (which gains flex + gap only when it holds more than one chip). Each entry is { text, theme, size, radius, variant } — ui/chip’s own standalone attributes, written verbatim: theme is a ui-chip theme string (default "pale accent"), size sm|lg|xl|2xl, radius non|rnd|pll|crc|sqr (rnd is the square-cornered look), variant light|outline. NOT to be confused with `furniture.chip`, which is the chip overlaid on the MEDIA: a frame gets one chip family, so a furniture chip suppresses the type label, which is why a status flag belongs here instead.

size.title: Size
size.description: ui-chip size — sm | lg | xl | 2xl (md is the default)

radius.title: Corner
radius.description: ui-chip radius — non | rnd | pll | crc | sqr; pill is the default

cover.title: Cover link
cover.description: Makes the WHOLE card clickable: the headline text is wrapped in one <a data-part="cover"> whose ::after stretches over the card. Safe over a carousel — the scroll-button/marker pseudos sit at z-index 3 and the overlay furniture at 2, against the cover's 1. Exactly one per card: nested anchors are invalid, so tag and action links are raised above it instead.

eyebrow.title: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: Category / kicker shown above the headline. Emitted as articleSection, category, recipeCategory or about depending on schemaType.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Primary headline. Emitted as headline (article/news), title (job) or name (all other types). Short rich text: inline <b> (emphasis) and <ui-gradient-text> (gradient treatment, optional animate slide|breathe and a bounded gradient="<colour stops>" list — hex, rgb()/hsl()/var() names, ≤80 chars) pass through; all other markup is stripped/escaped. Keep ≤256 chars — if the CMS cannot constrain rich text length, fall back to a plain rich text field. Plain strings remain valid.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Brief summary. Emitted as description — or reviewBody (review), text (quote/social).

readingTime.title: Reading Time
readingTime.description: Human-readable reading time, e.g. “5 min read”

media.title: Media
media.description: Media items rendered inside <ui-media>. One item = single frame; multiple items = carousel (nav dots/arrows).

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Image or video asset from the media library

src.title: External Source
src.description: External URL or provider video id — used when no asset is set (e.g. YouTube/Vimeo id). Map only: an explicit embed URL, bypassing the provider builder

provider.title: Map Provider
provider.description: Map only — google needs details.map.key; anything unbuildable falls back to OpenStreetMap

layer.title: Map Basemap
layer.description: Map only — the OpenStreetMap embed's layer= string. Allowlisted to the six basemaps OSM can embed; anything else renders Standard, which is what the embed itself does with an unknown id. tracestracktopo and openmaptiles_osm are in the OSM switcher but carry no canEmbed flag, so they are deliberately not offered.

latitude.title: Map Latitude
latitude.description: Map only — overrides details.geo.latitude when the map must show a different point

longitude.title: Map Longitude
longitude.description: Map only — overrides details.geo.longitude when the map must show a different point

alt.title: Alt Text
alt.description: Accessible description of the media item

poster.title: Poster
poster.description: Video/audio only — the still shown before playback, and the visual an audio item keeps in the frame

controls.title: Native Controls
controls.description: Video only — show the browser's own controls

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.description: Video only — implies muted; the renderer also sets playsinline

muted.title: Muted
muted.description: Video only — forced on when autoplay is set

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video only, ISO 8601 (e.g. PT2M10S) → VideoObject duration

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: Authors / reviewers / speakers — rendered as byline, emitted as author → Person

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Keywords — rendered as pill list (data-part="tags"), emitted as keywords

links.title: Links
links.description: Plain related links (rendered as text links, not buttons). Envelope tags accept a string or {name, url} — a linked tag renders an anchor inside the chip. An action with no link.url renders a real button element (with optional ariaLabel); modifiedDisplay adds a visible Updated line beside the machine dateModified

furniture.title: Furniture
furniture.description: Overlay elements placed on top of the media area: a chip label, a beacon (live/status indicator), a sticker callout, a save/favorite toggle and a play affordance. This model carries only their TEXT/semantic content — position, hue, size and shape are set in the preset's media= token string (chip/sticker/save/play/beacon tokens), optionally overridden per item via 'style'.

chip.title: Chip
chip.description: Small pill label overlaid on the media (<ui-chip>) — replaces the legacy ribbon.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Optional count/label rendered as a nested <ui-badge> (e.g. "4").

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra chip() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "red" or "bs red". Overrides the preset for the same axis (position/hue).

beacon.title: Beacon
beacon.description: Live/status indicator overlaid on the media (<ui-beacon>) — the animated counterpart to the static chip (e.g. LIVE, REC, Breaking). Marker-class: rendered text-only. Animations are gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; the paused attribute freezes a running one.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra beacon() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "red sld bln" or "ts pll". Axes: position (ts…be) · hue (red…white) · face (dts dots | pll pill | sld solid | tck ticker) · animation (bln blink | pls pulse | brt breathe | non none) · size (xs sm md lg xl 2xl) · corner (rnd sqr). Overrides the preset for the same axis.

sticker.title: Sticker
sticker.description: Callout disc/shape overlaid on the media (<ui-sticker>). Its multi-line typography is authored as 'lines' — each line renders as its own element and is styled by the sticker's font= / font-lead= tokens.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: One entry per typographic line. 'label' → <small> (font=), 'lead' → <strong> (font-lead=), 'plain' → <span> (fluid). Optional 'sup' renders a trailing <sup> (e.g. price cents).

sup.title: Superscript
sup.description: Optional <sup> appended after the text, e.g. price cents.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra sticker() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "sh:burst red" or "te sh:heart". Overrides the preset for the same axis (position/hue/shape).

marquee.title: Marquee
marquee.description: Full-width scrolling text band across the media (<ui-marquee>) — a BAND, not 9-grid furniture: it spans the frame's inline size, is positioned only top (default) or bot, and sits below the point furniture (chip/beacon/sticker). Text renders via aria-label on an empty element — no child markup.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra marquee() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "red sm rpt" or "bot fade". Overrides the preset for the same axis (position/hue/size/mode); unknown words are dropped by the renderer.

save.title: Save
save.description: Save/favorite toggle overlaid on the media (<ui-save>). The boolean value true is also accepted and defaults to a heart.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra save() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "orange sm" or "non" (hide the disc).

lightbox.title: Lightbox
lightbox.description: View-gallery / fullscreen toggle overlaid on the media (<ui-lightbox>). The renderer marks the frame as a popover and points the invoker at it (built-in toggle-popover command); the open-state presentation comes from the preset's open: tokens. The boolean value true is also accepted.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra lightbox() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "white sm" or "non" (hide the disc).

play.title: Play
play.description: Play/pause affordance overlaid on the media (<ui-play>) — for videos and autoplay carousels, where it becomes the sole play/pause control. The boolean value true is also accepted.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra play() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "lg" or "bs".

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Interaction statistics — emitted as interactionStatistic → InteractionCounter (WatchAction/LikeAction/ShareAction/CommentAction)

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Reference to a card-preset defining the look & feel: the host element (<ui-card> or <ui-reveal>) and its variant/media/content attribute token strings. Swap the reference to restyle the card without touching content. Falls back to the renderer's default (stack) when unset.

flipside.title: Flipside
flipside.description: Optional reference to another card whose content renders as the reveal back panel. Only used when the preset's element is ui-reveal. Unset: the back panel is derived from this card's own envelope + details. The flipside shares the host's schema.org scope — use the same schemaType (or the neutral 'content') to keep microdata coherent. Resolved one level deep; a flipside's own flipside is ignored.

details.title: Type Details
details.description: Type-specific data, discriminated by schemaType. An optional `subtype` applies to ANY type that has an allowlist — it sharpens the emitted itemtype to an allowlisted schema.org subtype of the base type (article, business, event, location, news, organization, product, social); values off the list are ignored and the base type is used. See ui/card/docs/schema.md § Subtypes for the full map. Expected shapes — product: { price:{current,original,currency,discountText}, availability, rating:{value,count,max}, sku, validUntil, validUntilDisplay, variants:{ variesBy[] (axis names — color/size/material/pattern; emitted as full schema.org URLs, unknown axes dropped), productGroupID, items:[{name, url (optional — renders a real crawlable <a> around the variant name; Google requires each variant be preselectable at a distinct URL), sku, color, size, material, pattern, price, currency, availability}] } (the ProductGroup variants block — emitted ONLY when subtype resolves to ProductGroup, since hasVariant/variesBy/productGroupID are ProductGroup-only properties; present-but-not-a-group leaves an HTML comment instead; the gate is the itemtype WRITTEN on the enclosing scope, which for a ui-reveal flipside is the HOST card’s. See ui/card/docs/schema.md § Product) } · event: { startDate, endDate, status, location:{name,address}, organizer:{name} } · recipe: { prepTime, cookTime, servings, ingredients[], instructions[] } · review: { rating:{value,max}, reviewer:{name,title,verified}, reviewDate, productReviewed, reviewedType (itemReviewed type — Product default; Organization/Service allowlisted, which makes the review a testimonial) } · job: { company, location, employmentType, salaryRange:{min,max,currency,period}, qualifications[], benefits[], applicationDeadline, employerRating:{value,count,max,organization,sameAs} (a SECOND TOP-LEVEL EmployerAggregateRating item — itemscope with NO itemprop, because the rating is of the EMPLOYER and JobPosting has no aggregateRating property at all) } · course: { duration, courseWorkload, difficultyLevel, instructor:{name,title} (emitted as CourseInstance.instructor → Person), provider (the Organization), price:{current,original,currency}, prerequisites[] } · booking: { serviceName, venue, capacity, duration, price:{hourlyRate,currency}, amenities[], cancellationPolicy } · poll: { options:[{headline,votes}], totalVotes } · profile: { jobTitle, organization, location, bio, contacts:[{type,value,label}] } (skills are envelope tags — Person gets knowsAbout automatically) · faq: { items:[{question,answer}] } · timeline: { items:[{date,endDate,location,headline,text,theme}] } (date becomes the subEvent required startDate) · gallery: { albumName, totalCount } (categories are envelope tags) · statistic: { metricName, currentValue (the MACHINE value — emitted as <meta itemprop="value">, never as the visible text), displayValue (the human string, may be abbreviated: "2.4M"), unit (a REAL unit of measurement — becomes unitText beside the machine value, so a magnitude abbreviation like M/k/bn belongs in displayValue, not here), trend, trendPercentage, comparisonPeriod, note } · achievement: { status (renders a pale-green meta chip), issuingOrganization, dateEarned, expirationDate, skillLevel, credentialId, verificationUrl } · goal: { status (active | completed | failed | potential — an allowlist mapped to schema.org ActionStatusType URLs; anything else emits no actionStatus), startDate, endDate, dateRangeDisplay, agentName (agent → Person), target:{name,value,unitText} (object → QuantitativeValue — the goal), current:{value,unitText} (result → QuantitativeValue — progress so far), progressLabel (the ring's small caption), progressDisplay (human line, e.g. "6 of 10 minutes"), hue (ring theme — the nine-hue allowlist; unknown values drop the attribute) } (the <ui-progress-circular> ring is presentation only and carries NO itemprop; its percent is COMPUTED from current/target, clamped 0–100, so the drawn arc can never contradict the metas. See ui/card/docs/schema.md § Goal) · announcement: { announcementType, priority, priorityDisplay, effectiveDate:{start,end}, targetAudience, actionRequired } · business: { businessType (LEGACY alias for the general `subtype` field — an allowlisted LocalBusiness subtype, e.g. Restaurant/CafeOrCoffeeShop; prefer `subtype` in new content, which wins when both are set), address:{streetAddress,addressLocality,postalCode,addressCountry}, telephone, email, website, priceRange, rating:{value,count,max}, sameAs[], foundingDate, geo:{latitude,longitude}, openingHours:[{schema, days?, time?}] (one entry per distinct opening pattern — ranges 'Mo-We 09:00-17:00' and single days 'Th 09:00-16:00'; rendered as a two-column day/time list, days+time derived from the schema string unless given explicitly; each row also emits a structured OpeningHoursSpecification) } · comparison: { items:[{name,price,image}], recommendation, summary } · contact: { contactType, department, availableHours, availableHoursDisplay, responseTime, languages (array or comma string — one availableLanguage each), contactMethods:[{type,value,label}] } · location: { address, geo:{latitude,longitude,url?,links?} (links[] is the external-map row — provider ids from an allowlist: google | apple | osm, or {provider,label?,url?} to override a label or supply a ready-made href. Present ⇒ it REPLACES the single derived "Open in Maps" CTA; every link is unmarked, because hasMap is declared once on the frame), openingHours:[{schema, days?, time?}] (or a plain hours string; a plain Place emits only openingHoursSpecification — the flat openingHours string is a LocalBusiness/CivicStructure property), contact, amenities[] } · places: { kind (business | residence — selects the ITEM shape; deliberately NOT `subtype`, which sharpens the ROOT itemtype, and the root is an ItemList in both), center:{latitude,longitude,url} (the point the no-JS fallback frame and the "Open in Maps" CTA use — note this is details.center, distinct from details.map, which carries map-PROVIDER options for the single-point embed), regionDisplay (visible text ONLY: about/spatialCoverage/areaServed are all out of domain on an ItemList), order (ItemListOrderAscending|ItemListOrderDescending|ItemListUnordered), ordered (false → <ul>), items[]: business → { type (LocalBusiness + its allowlisted subtypes), name, url, branchCode, geo, address, telephone, email, openingHours[] } · residence → { type (the Accommodation subtree only — Residence and ApartmentComplex are Place, not Accommodation, and can carry none of these facts), name, url, datePosted, price:{currency,amount}, geo, address, floorSize, numberOfBedrooms, numberOfRooms, yearBuilt }. A residence item renders as a RealEstateListing wrapping the Accommodation in mainEntity, because `offers` is out of domain on Apartment, on Place AND on ListItem. tags emit NO keywords (out of domain on an Intangible) and the frame carries no hasMap (a Place property). See ui/card/docs/schema.md § Places } · filelist: { files:[{name, url, download (the suggested download filename — rides the HTML download attribute; absent → the bare attribute keeps the served filename), size (human string, e.g. "2.4 MB" — emitted verbatim as contentSize, whose range is Text), type (pdf | excel | word | txt | zip — a closed allowlist that picks BOTH the row's ::marker glyph and the encodingFormat MIME type; an unknown value gets the generic draft glyph and NO encodingFormat, so author data never reaches a machine surface)}], note } (root ItemList — each file is itemListElement → MediaObject carrying name/contentUrl/contentSize/encodingFormat; always an unordered <ul>, because the per-row file icons ride list-style-type and ordinal markers cannot coexist with them; tags emit NO keywords, out of domain on an Intangible. See ui/card/docs/schema.md § File list) · membership: { price:{monthly,yearly,currency}, trialPeriod, features[], limitations[], isPopular (renders a Most-popular chip; override the words with popularText) } · social: { platform, author } (hashtags are envelope tags) · software: { version (shown as a pale-accent chip), applicationCategory, operatingSystem[], developer:{name,website}, price:{current,currency} } · organization: { foundingDate, foundingDateDisplay, numberOfEmployees, sameAs[], email, headquarters:{address:{streetAddress,postalCode,addressLocality,addressCountry}, geo:{latitude,longitude} — emitted as location → Place → geo, since Organization itself has no geo property}, offices:[{name, address:{streetAddress,addressLocality,addressCountry}, geo:{latitude,longitude}, telephone, email, openingHours:[{schema, days?, time?}]}] (offices emit department → LocalBusiness, each with its own per-day hours table) } · video: { durationDisplay (shown as a pale-accent chip), viewsDisplay, creator:{name} } (machine duration/uploadDate ride the media item; eyebrow → genre, published → uploadDate) · howto: { totalTime, estimatedCost:{value,currency}, difficulty, supplies[], tools[], steps:[{name,text}] } · qa: { question, upvotes, answers:[{text, author, upvotes, accepted}] } · podcast: { seriesName, episodeNumber, duration, durationDisplay, audioUrl } · movie: { dateReleased, dateReleasedDisplay, duration, durationDisplay, contentRating, director:{name}, actors[], rating:{value,count,max} } (eyebrow → genre) · book: { isbn, numberOfPages, bookFormat (schema.org BookFormatType member), bookFormatDisplay, publisher, rating:{value,count,max}, price:{current,currency} } · dataset: { license, licenseDisplay, temporalCoverage, temporalCoverageDisplay (human range with en dash; machine ISO interval stays in the meta), spatialCoverage, variableMeasured[], distribution:[{format,url}] } · claim: { claim, claimant, reviewDate, verdict:{value,max,label} } · loyalty: { hostingOrganization, joinUrl, joinText (the CTA carries the programme's own url), tiers:[{name, pointsEarned, url (Google lists url as recommended on each TIER, not only on the programme), requirement (free text) OR requirementAmount:{currency,value} (a nested MonetaryAmount — hasTierRequirement is polymorphic), requirementNote, benefits:[{type,text}]}] } (benefit type is a TierBenefitEnumeration member — TierBenefitLoyaltyPoints/Price/Returns/Shipping; an unknown value drops the meta and keeps the visible text. All four are valid schema.org, but Google reads only Points and Price, so a tier whose ONLY benefits are Returns/Shipping is ineligible) · quiz: { format (

), subject (emits about → Thing plus a hidden educationalAlignment → AlignmentObject), pace, cards:[{question, answer | options:[{text, correct}]}] } — format picks the shape and both itemprop values; a multiple-choice deck with a lay-out preset (card-preset/quiz-carousel) renders one card per question in a scroller (one card = hasPart → Question with exactly one acceptedAnswer → Answer; learningResourceType and eduQuestionType are FIXED to "Flashcard" — eduQuestionType is a Question property, Quiz owns none of its own, and any other value makes the card ineligible) · service: { serviceType, provider (→ Organization), areaServed (→ Place), catalog:{name, period, items:[{name,price,currency}]} (hasOfferCatalog → OfferCatalog → itemListElement → Offer → itemOffered → Service, since OfferCatalog is an ItemList), channel:{languages[], processingTime, url, urlText, telephone, contactType} (availableChannel → ServiceChannel wrapping the actions row; servicePhone expects a ContactPoint, so the tel: link carries telephone inside that scope while serviceUrl sits on the CTA) } · realestate: { datePosted, datePostedDisplay, agent, viewings, availability, price:{amount,currency,note}, property:{type, name, floorLevel, petsAllowed, floorSize, floorSizeUnit (default MTK), floorSizeLabel, bedrooms, bathrooms, rooms, yearBuilt, address:{streetAddress,postalCode,addressLocality,addressCountry}, amenities[]} } (RealEstateListing is a WebPage: the home hangs off mainEntity, whose `type` resolves through an ACCOMMODATION allowlist — Accommodation/Apartment/House/SingleFamilyResidence/Suite/Room; Residence and ApartmentComplex are Place, not Accommodation, and are refused. `offers` is not valid on Accommodation/Place, so the price rides the LISTING, outside that scope. Every strictly-numeric property emits its machine value as <meta content> with the unit words in a separate text node — <data value="3">3 bedrooms</data> reads as the string "3 bedrooms" and is rejected) · menu: { note, sections:[{name, items:[{name, price, currency, label (the visible diet chip), labelTheme (default "pale green"), labelSize (ui-chip size, default "sm" — the chip shares a tight auto/1fr/auto row with the name and the price), description, diets[] (RestrictedDiet members, emitted as suitableForDiet URLs; unknown values dropped), nutrition:{calories,proteinContent,servingSize}}]}] } (hasMenuSection → MenuSection → hasMenuItem → MenuItem; Menu and MenuSection are CreativeWorks while MenuItem is an Intangible, which is why only the item gets offers/nutrition/suitableForDiet. calories is an Energy and servingSize is Text, so both are unit-bearing strings) · tvseries: { numberOfSeasons, numberOfEpisodes, startDate, contentRating, rating:{value,count,max}, director:{name,label} (the label carries its own punctuation — "Created and directed by" against a film's "Director:"), actors[], ordered (default true), seasons:[{seasonNumber,numberOfEpisodes,name,display}] } (containsSeason → TVSeason; eyebrow → genre; the superseded actors/episodes/seasons spellings are never emitted) · tvepisode: { episodeNumber, duration, durationDisplay, datePublished, datePublishedDisplay, seriesName, season:{seasonNumber,name}, director:{name,label}, actors[] } (episodeNumber/partOfSeason/partOfSeries/duration are all inherited from Episode, not declared on TVEpisode) · medical: { specialty (a MedicalSpecialty member — anything else is dropped), lastReviewed, lastReviewedDisplay, reviewedLabel, audience:{type,name} (medicalAudience takes the TYPE MedicalAudience or its subtype Patient — NOT the similarly named MedicalAudienceType enumeration, whose only members are Clinician and MedicalResearcher), about:{type (MedicalCondition/Drug/MedicalProcedure), name, aspects:[{type (signOrSymptom/riskFactor/possibleTreatment), text}]}, reviewedBy:{name,role,avatar}, disclaimer } (specialty/reviewedBy/lastReviewed are WebPage properties MedicalWebPage merely inherits; the reviewedBy byline is VISIBLE markup, never a hidden meta — it is the E-E-A-T signal) · music: { artist (byArtist → MusicGroup, rendered in the subheadline slot), numTracks (DERIVED from the track list unless stated — state it only for a partial listing), datePublished, datePublishedDisplay, durationDisplay, productionType (a MusicAlbumProductionType member), releaseType (a MusicAlbumReleaseType member), ordered (default true), tracks:[{name,position,duration,durationDisplay}], note } (numTracks and track come from MusicPlaylist, the album's parent; `tracks` is superseded. Every track also carries byArtist — the album's artist, or its own `artist` for a compilation or guest feature — because microdata has no reference-by-id for a property VALUE the way JSON-LD's `@id` does. `artistUrl` wraps the subheadline artist in a crawlable <a itemprop="url">, the reciprocal of the band card's album rows. eyebrow → genre) · musicgroup: { genres[] (the eyebrow carries the PRIMARY genre; these are the rest, machine-only), foundingDate, foundingDateDisplay, foundingLocation, members:[{role,name}] (member → Person, the instrument an editorial label OUTSIDE the scope; `members` and `musicGroupMember` are both superseded), albums:[{name,datePublished,numTracks,url,display}] (album → MusicAlbum; `albums` is superseded), ordered (default FALSE — a discography descends, so ordinal markers would lie), sameAs[], note } · glossary: { about, note, terms:[{name,termCode,description}] } (hasDefinedTerm → DefinedTerm; DefinedTerm is an Intangible, DefinedTermSet a CreativeWork — both still pending.schema.org) · podcastseries: { startDate, cadence, episodeCount, feed:{url,text} (webFeed rides a real <a href> so the feed is crawlable), host:{name,role,avatar}, ordered (default FALSE — episodes descend, so ordinal markers would lie), episodes:[{episodeNumber,name,duration,durationDisplay}], note } (there is NO episode-count property on PodcastSeries: numberOfEpisodes' domain is CreativeWorkSeason/RadioSeries/TVSeries/VideoGameSeries. The count is prose; hasPart is the machine answer) · vacationrental: { additionalType (Google’s own vocabulary, e.g. HolidayVillageRental — additionalType is Text|URL, and neither HolidayVillageRental nor EntirePlace is a schema.org class), identifier, brand (→ Brand, rendered as a visible "Hosted by" line), priceRange, checkin/checkout (Time, e.g. "16:00:00+02:00") + checkinDisplay/checkoutDisplay, languages[] (one knowsLanguage meta each, never a joined string), rating:{value,count,max}, geo:{latitude,longitude,url}, map, address:{streetAddress,postalCode,addressLocality,addressRegion,addressCountry}, reviews:[{author,rating,max,datePublished,dateDisplay,stayed,body}], property:{additionalType,name,petsAllowed,floorSize,floorSizeUnit,floorSizeLabel,bedrooms,bathrooms,rooms,sleeps,beds:[{count,type}],amenities[]} } (VacationRental ⊂ LodgingBusiness ⊂ LocalBusiness ⊂ Organization AND Place — which is what puts brand/knowsLanguage and latitude/longitude/containsPlace on the same element. The rooms hang off containsPlace → Accommodation because bed/occupancy/floorSize are Accommodation properties. `offers` is NOT in domain (no Organization, no Place), so the nightly rate rides priceRange. latitude/longitude are stated FLAT and the geo scope is never emitted — both spell the same coordinates. contentReferenceTime is deliberately dropped from reviews: its range is DateTime and a stay is known only to the month) · content/article/news/quote: no details needed (envelope only).
